spans.s: gutti (MIndic for gupti, which is recorded in Skt. Lex. in this sense, and similarly AMg. gutta), hole or cave, used as lair by animals: Mv 〔i.20.6〕 and 〔23.1〕 randhreṣu (? mss. corrupt) vā guttīṣu vā kārāsu vā bandheṣu vā sāhikānāṃ vā kiṃpuruṣ(ak)āṇāṃ (? see s.v.) vā undurūṇāṃ vā biḍālānāṃ vā ajagarāṇāṃ vā bile(ṣu) … However, the whole passage is doubtful; mss. very corrupt.
